title: Romantic Getaway to Costa Rica: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Costa Rica. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Costa Rica sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Trypinn Experts
content:
Costa Rica is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Costa Rica, the experience is nothing short of transformative.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Costa Rica
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Costa Rica](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1536708880921-03a9306ec47d?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Costa Rica's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Charming bed and breakfasts in Costa Rica provide cozy accommodations with home-cooked breakfasts.
